discription: An FM synthesis based organ-like sound with a vibrato LFO on the carrier frequency, controlled by an ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, modIndex=3, modRatio=1.5, vibratoRate=5, vibratoDepth=0.005; var sig, env, mod, lfo; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.5, 0.7, 0.8, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); lfo = LFSin.kr(vibratoRate).range(1 - vibratoDepth, 1 + vibratoDepth); mod = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio, 0, freq * modIndex); sig = SinOsc.ar(freq * lfo + mod) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
